budget_plans_one_kind.name: budget_plans_one_kind
budget_plans_one_kind.value:
("budget_plans"."amount_minor" is null) = ("budget_plans"."currency" is null)
        and not ("budget_plans"."amount_minor" is not null and "budget_plans"."percent" is not null)

budget_plans_savings_is_share.name: budget_plans_savings_is_share
budget_plans_savings_is_share.value: "budget_plans"."category_id" is not null or "budget_plans"."amount_minor" is null

catalogue_merges_item_live.name: catalogue_merges_item_live
catalogue_merges_item_live.where: "catalogue_merges"."undone_at" is null and "catalogue_merges"."from_item" is not null

catalogue_merges_place_live.name: catalogue_merges_place_live
catalogue_merges_place_live.where: "catalogue_merges"."undone_at" is null and "catalogue_merges"."from_place" is not null

catalogue_merges_subject_named.name: catalogue_merges_subject_named
catalogue_merges_subject_named.value:
case "catalogue_merges"."subject" when 'item'
        then "catalogue_merges"."from_item" is not null and "catalogue_merges"."into_item" is not null
          and "catalogue_merges"."from_place" is null and "catalogue_merges"."into_place" is null
        else "catalogue_merges"."from_place" is not null and "catalogue_merges"."into_place" is not null
          and "catalogue_merges"."from_item" is null and "catalogue_merges"."into_item" is null end

events_payload_matches_type.name: events_payload_matches_type
events_payload_matches_type.value:
("events"."type" not in ('catalogue_viewed', 'advice_viewed')
             or (jsonb_exists("events"."payload", 'subject')
                 and "events"."payload" ->> 'subject' in ('product', 'venue')
                 and "events"."payload" - 'subject' = '{}'::jsonb))
          and ("events"."type" <> 'session_started'
             or "events"."payload" = '{}'::jsonb)

failures_lengths.name: failures_lengths
failures_lengths.value:
char_length("failures"."error_name") between 1 and 64
          and ("failures"."code" is null or char_length("failures"."code") <= 64)
          and ("failures"."route" is null or char_length("failures"."route") <= 200)
          and cardinality("failures"."frames") <= 8

failures_platform_phone.name: failures_platform_phone
failures_platform_phone.value:
("failures"."platform" is not null) = ("failures"."source" = 'phone')
          and ("failures"."platform" is null or char_length("failures"."platform") <= 32)

generated.as: case when thread_id is not null then true end

open_food_facts_names_found.name: open_food_facts_names_found
open_food_facts_names_found.value: "open_food_facts"."found" = ("open_food_facts"."name_ru" is not null) and "open_food_facts"."found" = ("open_food_facts"."name_en" is not null)

receipts_untold_idx.name: receipts_untold_idx
receipts_untold_idx.where: "receipts"."status" in ('parsed', 'failed') and "receipts"."heard" is null and "receipts"."deleted_at" is null

spending_categories_preset_or_own.name: spending_categories_preset_or_own
spending_categories_preset_or_own.value:
("spending_categories"."preset" is not null and "spending_categories"."name" is null and "spending_categories"."colour" is null)
        or ("spending_categories"."preset" is null and "spending_categories"."name" is not null and "spending_categories"."colour" is not null)

spendings_debited_needs_account.name: spendings_debited_needs_account
spendings_debited_needs_account.value: "spendings"."debited_minor" is null or ("spendings"."account_id" is not null and "spendings"."debited_minor" > 0)

trips_rate_provider_matches_source.name: trips_rate_provider_matches_source
trips_rate_provider_matches_source.value:
("trips"."rate_source" is null or "trips"."rate_source" = 'personal') = ("trips"."rate_provider" is null)
        and (("trips"."rate_source" = 'official') = ("trips"."rate_provider" = (case when "trips"."rate_base" = 'GEL' then 'nbg' when "trips"."rate_quote" = 'GEL' then 'nbg' else 'cba' end))) is not false

trips_rate_choice_held.name: trips_rate_choice_held
trips_rate_choice_held.value: "trips"."rate_choice" is null or ("trips"."rate_jumped" and ("trips"."rate_choice" <> 'previous' or "trips"."rate_previous_scaled" is not null) and ("trips"."rate_choice" <> 'manual' or "trips"."rate_manual_scaled" is not null))

trips_receipt_whole.name: trips_receipt_whole
trips_receipt_whole.value:
num_nonnulls("trips"."receipt_minor", "trips"."receipt_currency") in (0, 2)
        and ("trips"."receipt_minor" is null or ("trips"."receipt_minor" > 0 and "trips"."receipt_set_at" is not null))

trips_debited_needs_account.name: trips_debited_needs_account
trips_debited_needs_account.value: "trips"."debited_minor" is null or ("trips"."account_id" is not null and "trips"."debited_minor" > 0)
